description.value: A hotel in the heart of downtown Invermere, part of the INNhotels chain, with an onsite restaurant (Begginnings) serving breakfast, brunch, and lunch with locally sourced ingredients. The location puts guests steps from Kinsmen Beach, the Invermere Farmer's Market, and downtown shops, making it a convenient base for exploring the Columbia Valley. Pet-friendly ground-floor rooms are available by request.

address.value: 1310-7th Ave, Box 1080, Invermere, BC V0A 1K0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the hotel is open and operating at the OSM address, with matching phone, email, and address. No bike-specific amenities (secure storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields are null. WiFi is explicitly listed in all room types, and a Breakfast To-Go bag is explicitly described for early departures, qualifying as a packed breakfast; the front page also notes Restaurants & Cafes within 30 steps, supporting nearby evening food.
concerns: The contact page lists the same number (1-800-661-8911) for both Toll Free and Fax, which appears to be a data entry error on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating hotel in downtown Invermere with an active website and booking system; a straightforward accommodation option for touring cyclists in the Columbia Valley.

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Breakfast To-Go bag explicitly offered for early departures; includes fresh fruit, granola bar, yogurt, muffin, and fruit juice; can be ordered in advance or requested at the front desk

Nearby evening food.detail: Website lists Restaurants & Cafes within 30 steps of the hotel

price.label: Mid-range
price.signal: downtown Invermere hotel with restaurant, INNhotels chain; $140-190
